This video offers an in-depth exploration of the **16 Hindu samskaras (sacraments)**—sacred rites of passage that mark significant milestones in an individual's journey from birth to adulthood. Rooted in Vedic traditions, these rituals emphasize **spiritual purity, cultural heritage, and personal growth**.
